description: Search providers with a current ACI Risk Indicator by free text and/or module, risk band, or subtype. Returns headline fields for each match: `slug`, `name`, `module`, the indicator value (`score`), `risk_band` and `subtype`. Access: no sign-in needed. Below the Professional plan, results show name, module and risk band only.

query.description: Free-text match on provider name or slug.

risk_band.description: Filter by risk band: LOW|MEDIUM|ELEVATED|HIGH, or `NO_CURRENT_INDICATOR` for providers whose criteria were all not applicable (returned with a null `risk_band`). `NOT_RATED` was renamed `NO_CURRENT_INDICATOR` on 2026-10-08; requests using `NOT_RATED` are accepted until 2027-01-06.

name: search_providers
title: Search ACI Providers
